query.sql: WITH ordered_presence AS ( SELECT "$producer" AS producer, CAST(strftime('%s', "$arriveTime") AS REAL) AS current_epoch FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MASclOcurrence' ), time_deltas AS ( SELECT producer, current_epoch - LAG(current_epoch) OVER (PARTITION BY producer ORDER BY current_epoch ASC) AS delta_seconds FROM ordered_presence ) SELECT producer AS "$producer", COUNT(delta_seconds) AS total_intervals, ROUND(AVG(delta_seconds), 2) AS avg_interval_seconds, ROUND(AVG(delta_seconds) / 60.0, 2) AS avg_interval_minutes FROM time_deltas WHERE delta_seconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY producer
